# MotionFlow Toolkit Package

This folder is already packaged and ready to be copied into the Adobe CEP extension directory.

Structure:

MotionFlowToolkit/
├── CSXS/
│   └── manifest.xml
├── extension/
│   ├── css/
│   │   └── styles.css
│   ├── js/
│   │   └── main.js
│   └── index.html
├── scripts/
│   └── AfterEffectsMotionFlow.jsx
└── README.txt

Install steps:

Windows:
C:\Program Files\Common Files\Adobe\CEP\extensions\MotionFlowToolkit

macOS:
/Library/Application Support/Adobe/CEP/extensions/MotionFlowToolkit

Then reopen After Effects and open Window > MotionFlow Toolkit

If you want a .zxp package, use Adobe ZXPSignCmd or Extension Manager for signed distribution.
